title: Zealot catalog index v1
description: Task 27a. Read app/services/catalog_index/serializer.rb and docs/catalog_index_v1.md alongside this file -- all three are kept in sync by hand.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601. 27b makes this strictly increasing run over run; v1's serializer just emits whatever it's given.

id.description: Zealot's App#id. Stable -- D-Store should key off this, not name/package_name.

package_name.description: Android application id (App#play_package_name). Null for an app with no Play package set yet -- v1 has no iOS bundle-id field, see docs.

listing_status.description: Included for completeness/debugging. Production generation (27c) is expected to only include listing_status == "live" apps at all -- this field is not how a consumer should filter.

verified.description: Always false in v1 -- no company verification (KYB) exists yet. Not a signal to trust until Task 27's ❓1 area lands.

description.description: Reserved for 27e (store-listing editor). Always null in v1.

icon.description: Reserved for 27d. Always {url: null, sha256: null} in v1.

latest_version.description: null only when the app has no releases at all.

download_url.description: Zealot's own stable /download/releases/:id endpoint. NEVER a signed storage URL directly -- those expire; D-Store must link to this, not cache a signed one.

sha256.description: Of the file download_url actually serves. Null when not yet computable (e.g. the local copy has already been mirrored-and-wiped, see Task 19) -- 27b is expected to persist this so it stops being null in steady state.

signing_fingerprint.description: AndroidSigningKey's checksum (Release#signing_key_checksum). Null for a release that never went through the org-signed delivery path.
